_comment: Caveat days whose CAUSE has been fixed (owner 11-21, standing order for every calendar). index.html (ledgerCavFix / ledgerCavResolve) reads this file once per load: a hatched calendar or chart day turns from AMBER (open) to BLUE (cause fixed) when EVERY caveat on that day matches an entry here - same calendar ('qb' = WEBULL PAPER, 'p2' = NT8 PAPER, '*' = any), the caveat's cause code in kinds, and from <= day <= (to, else fixed_on). A day with one fixed and one open caveat stays amber and its hover names the fixed part. Cause codes: qb = tape_reprice, fill_outside_minute, fill_band, parity_old, book_only_broker, book_only_infra, book_only, feed_invalid; p2 = roll_splice, orb_lookahead. Add an entry only when the cause is fixed in code and shipped; cite the commit in ref and say the fix in plain words in note (it is shown after 'fixed:'). Never widen 'to' past the fix: a cause that comes back after it must stay amber.

fixes.note: the book no longer reads NinjaTrader's feed - it runs on its own cloud signal engine, so an adapter restart cannot blank a day
the end-of-day flatten fired at 16:00:02, after the bell, with no live price; it runs at 15:59 again and prices from the live stream
Webull refused 8 NOISE orders (HTTP 417) because the legs sent opposite orders on one account; legs now net into one Webull position on the margin account, and no broker refusal since
8 NOISE trades never sent after the Firestore free-quota read for the host lease failed at about 14:35 ET; the box now holds a local lease (0 Firestore reads), verified 11-20
the data refresh now refuses a bar that spans a contract switch and shadow paper refuses a capture tail from another contract (first live roll since: December 2026)
